object.name: evi.reson~
object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP <o>reson~</o> as a TPT filter
object.description: A linear TPT resonant bandpass filter. <o>evi.reson~</o> has a very similar response as MSP <o>reson~</o> and can therefore be used as a drop in replacement in most situations, but has better modulation characteristics with FM-able center frequency as well as optional auto gain compensation.
object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of MSP filters in evieve, see the 'evieve: msp' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.description: Center frequency of the resonant peak.
Filter resonance. Can be increasingly high values (e.g. 10000). See @compensate attribute for compensation.

attributes.name: compensate
attributes.description: Automatically compensate for the perceived reduction in gain (energy) when Q values are very high. Typically this should be on but is off by default to match MSP.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smooth the mixing gains of the filter efficiently at the core of the DSP. With these TPT SVF filters this will usually be the only smoothing required. By default smoothing is off.
